description: F-THREAD-01 — M8 cosmetic thread on a Φ8 boss. Smoke fixture for W6 (hole-wizard threads section) + W7 (geometric-mode regression — same designation rebuilt with mode='geometric' must produce the same callout). Pure data: catalog ref + cosmetic feature shape + expected metadata.
notes: Cosmetic mode returns the parent geometry unchanged (reference equality) per spec §10.1.
M8 coarse pitch is 1.25 mm; the callout suppresses the pitch (ISO 6410-1) — 'M8-6g' not 'M8×1.25-6g'.
Class '6g' is the external-thread default per spec §3.3 (this fixture is external since `threadKind = 'external'`).
W7 will rebuild the same fixture with `mode: 'geometric'` and assert callout + designation are identical.
